name: Bharat Parallel Corpus Collection (BPCC)
description: The Bharat Parallel Corpus Collection (BPCC) is a massive parallel corpora suite spanning English and all 22 scheduled Indian languages, created by AI4Bharat for IndicTrans2. It contains approximately 230 million sentence pairs, including 2.2 million high-quality human-translated and verified sentence pairs (BPCC-Human) and 228 million filtered mined pairs, representing the most comprehensive translation corpus for South Asian languages.

license.name: Composite: CC BY 4.0 (Human & Test Splits) / CC0 1.0 (Mined & Packaging)
license.notes: BPCC is a multi-license composite collection: (1) CC BY 4.0 applies to newly added human-translated seed corpora (BPCC-H-Wiki, BPCC-H-Daily, ~2.2M pairs) and the IN-22 evaluation benchmark test sets (IN22-Gen, IN22-Conv); (2) CC0 1.0 Universal applies to the curation and packaging of mined corpora (BPCC-Mined) and back-translated data (BPCC-BT). Underlying crawled text remains subject to original source copyright.

provenance.curation_notes: Filtered using dual-encoder semantic sentence embedding scoring and strict cross-lingual length penalties.
